item.tib: byams ma gza' yi 'jigs skyobs kyi cha lag man ngag zur gsal
item.coloph: zhes byams ma gza' skyobs kyi cha lag tu gso bya'i nad 'bum gyi gza' bcos phan bde'i 'byung gnas kyi gsal byed 'di nyid ni skyabs gnas dam pa'i phyag khrid bzhin/ 'bras bu'i sgrub gnas bya dur gnam thos ri khrod du/ sgo btsun rnam tshul ming gis 'phral du bris pas/ nor 'khrul gyur na skyabs gnas tshogs la bshags pa'o/ dge bas 'gro ba yongs la phan thog shog/
